matches.rationale: Finding 2 targets exactly the Section 3 proof (Lemma 3.1) and argues that Lemma 2.4 is applied inappropriately because the path/tree is selected after the noise is drawn, i.e. the relevant path structure is not fixed/known independently of the private weights — the same defect the ground truth records as the false assumption that shortest-path-tree topology is public plus the illegitimate use of Lemma 2.4.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correct but harmless observation of a missing n≥1 hypothesis in an auxiliary appendix proposition, not among the ground-truth defects.
Credited in Part 1 as detecting the misapplication of Lemma 2.4 under the non-public/noise-dependent path (tree) assumption.
Arithmetically plausible observation that the Lemma 4.4 size bound exceeds n for large k; a pre-existing gap, not a listed ground-truth defect.
The stated log^{2.5} factor in Theorem 4.3 plausibly already absorbs the log n from t·k trees; the claimed dropped factor is a misreading of the bookkeeping.
Same unsupported log-factor accounting claim applied to Theorem 4.4, not a defect the paper supports.
